excerpt: The D extension widens the 32 floating-point registers, `f0-f31`, to 64 bits (FLEN=64 in <<fprs>>).
If extension Smstateen is implemented together with Smcsrind, bit 60 of state-enable register mstateen0 controls access to siselect, sireg*, vsiselect, and vsireg*.
If the hypervisor extension is implemented, the same bit is defined also in hypervisor CSR hstateen0, but controls access to only siselect and sireg*.
The `mtvec` register must always be implemented, but can contain a read-only value.
an implementation may make any subset of the counters read-only zero.
The `mtval` register can optionally also be used to return the faulting instruction bits on an illegal-instruction exception.
WFI is available in all privileged modes, and optionally available to U-mode.
Not all physical address bits may be implemented, and so the `pmpaddr` registers are WARL.
The Zvknhb and Zvbc Vector Crypto Extensions --and accordingly the composite extensions Zvkn, Zvknc, Zvkng, and Zvksc-- depend on Zve64x.
If Zcmt is implemented then jvt must also be implemented, but can contain a read-only value.
